devin: CI perf check failed on PR #10023 — microbench threshold diff: kv-batcher tail latency +12% on x86-rt64. see CI: <https://ci.redwood/inference/10023>
perf-bot: [auto] perf/regression detected: microbench_kv_batcher_tail_latency exceeded threshold on x86-rt64. baseline=12.3ms new=13.8ms delta=+12.2% (p<0.01). artifacts: <https://ci.redwood/artifacts/10023> :warning:
maria: ouch. which change in the PR touches batching or prefetching? any flamegraphs attached?
ben: starting a quick bisect locally with the perf harness. suspect the prefetch heuristic tweak landed recently.
ben: git bisect start --term-old=good --term-new=bad
ben: git bisect bad HEAD
ben: git bisect good a1b2c3d4
ben: running microbench: ./tools/bench-runner --target microbench_kv_batcher --arch x86-rt64 --repeat 20
perf-bot: quick summary from CI artifact:
```
Summary (artifact id 10023):
batch_waiter            38.1%
kernel_selector::score  25.4%
kv_cache::lookup         7.2%
other                  29.3%

Metrics: tail_latency_ms = 13.8 (was 12.3)
```

sophie: i landed a small change to the prefetch throttling logic two PRs ago (rfc-547 style), it biases prefetching towards high-seqlen traces and added a short delay to avoid thrashing. hash d4e5f6c7. could increase batch wait for mixed seqlen workloads.
maria: ben — any bisect progress? can you confirm d4e5f6c7?
ben: bisect finished — good at a1b2c3d4, bad at HEAD, first bad commit reported: d4e5f6c7 (sophie)
ben: repro locally with bench-runner, runs match CI delta ~+11-13% tail.
devin: that crosses our rollback threshold (10%). mark as rollout-blocker? :exclamation:
maria: yeah, marking as rollout-blocker. opening revert PR for d4e5f6c7 now. also adding a unit microbench that simulates mixed-seqlen traces.
ben: created local patch to revert, running CI smoke. will push revert PR after green.
ci-bot: created issue INF-4321: "microbench: kv-batcher tail latency regression — d4e5f6c7" and created revert PR #10024.
maria: action items: 1) revert d4e5f6c7 (PR #10024) 2) add targeted microbench to catch prefetch throttling regressions 3) run regression job across x86-rt64 and A100 pools 4) postmortem with flamegraphs and batch_waiter breakdown.
sophie: sorry — i missed the mixed-seqlen impact. i'll work with maria on a safer heuristic and add perf tests.
devin: thanks everyone — treat as high priority. i'll hold the rollout until CI confirms revert fixes it. :thumbsup:
